instruction: Adjust Chrome's default font size to 14 pixels for a comfortable reading experience.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting default font size in Chrome to exactly 14 pixels for a balanced, comfortable reading experience. Evaluator checks if default_font_size == 14. Uses custom getter to extract default_font_size from Chrome preferences and custom metric to validate the exact value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts Chrome's default font size from webkit.webprefs.default_font_size in the Preferences file
Getter handles all OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux) with correct file paths
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - receives rules dict directly and accesses expected['type'] and expected['value']
Metric correctly compares default_font_size == 14 as required by instruction
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure preferences are saved and reloaded from disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires font size = 14 pixels, evaluator checks exactly that
Expected value (14) semantically matches instruction requirement
Error handling present with sensible default (16) if preferences cannot be read
